header.title: Welcome
scan-3d-steps: Select the book cover you want to scan;
Point the main camera of your device at the front cover of the selected book.
scan-content-steps: Select 'Scan Content' from the app menu;
Choose a page from the book and scan the back camera toward the QR code inside it;
Audio-video elements from the list will load automatically.

camera-access.camera-access-error: 🚨 Camera access is blocked! 1️⃣ Click the 🔒 (lock) icon in the address bar.2️⃣ Select "Site settings." 3️⃣ Find "Camera" and choose "Allow." 4️⃣ Refresh the page.
